text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, pant... Ya beat me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She's so tough! There's no way I<n>can match that
resolve...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The fateful battle has been decided!<n>The winner of
this year's Arima<n>Kinen is... Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Trainer! I'm a Grand Prix<n>winner! And that
means...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You're a Grand Prix trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I should be the one thanking you! I... I<n>just...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, come and join me in the winner's<n>circle!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone. I'm Super Creek, the<n>former villain.
♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I'm actually just<n>a motherly
Umamusume who wants<n>to coddle her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for your support<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You can coddle me anytime!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're all very important to me,<n>so I want
you all to listen to what I<n>have to say!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please be careful on your way home.<n>The Arima
Kinen isn't over until<n>you're back safe!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A unified response. Super Creek<n>appears to have
captured<n>everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'd like to finish off with some<n>special
congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now that my trainer has become<n>number one in the
world, I'd like to<n>offer a reward as a way of
expressing my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She pulls me out to stand in front of<n>everyone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You've really become so capable,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And it's thanks to you that I've been<n>able to
achieve such wonderful<n>results over these past
three years.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But my career is hardly about results.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's about you and me, and<n>everything we've built
together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: We both try to hold back our tears.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You've done such a great job. Okay,<n>here I go...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Who's a good trainer?! You are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I close my eyes and soak it in.<n>There's nothing like
getting praised<n>and patted when you're on top of
the<n>world.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, I have no idea what's<n>happening.
My body is enveloped in a<n>strange sensation...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And I soon find myself wrapped in<n>Super Creek's
warm embrace.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so much.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming into my life. I'm<n>so glad to
have met you... You are my<n>everything!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My body trembles with emotion as I<n>continue to
look up towards the sky,<n>unable to even hug her
back.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm finally a first-class trainer. The<n>sky should feel
distant and<n>unreachable...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Yet now, as Super Creek holds me up<n>in her tight
embrace, it feels so very<n>close.
